notes.title: Patch 1: Caviar
notes.notes:
This patch:

Added WASD keyboard support.
Leaderboard now displays top 20 instead of only 10
Beating the game now allows you to reset the game
Added new names to fish name setting
Changed hoodie goal from 30 to 25
Nerfed boxfish size
Made cave-fish enemies smaller
Stopped a score exploit :)
Player now always eats even sized fish
Reduced Leaderboard applause volume
